Analyses changes in surface cover types (lichen, moss, soil crust, forb, graminoid,
bare soil, stones) across the moraine-age chronosequence (A = young → B = intermediate
→ C = old) at two glacier locations (Nubra, Tsomoriri).

**Input:** `Glacier_Soil_Topo_merged.xlsx` (project root)

**Open `Glacier Transects.Rproj`**, then Knit.

```{r project-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!file.exists("Glacier Transects.Rproj") && file.exists("../Glacier Transects.Rproj")) {
  setwd("..")
}
stopifnot("Open Glacier Transects.Rproj first" = file.exists("Glacier Transects.Rproj"))

project_root  <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
molecular_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(project_root, "Molecular"),
                               winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(multcompView)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(lavaan)
  library(piecewiseSEM)
  library(svglite)
})

# Illustrator-friendly SVG export (plain text/lines; avoids grDevices filter stacks).
save_gg_svg <- function(filename, plot, width, height, bg = "white") {
  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    device = svglite,
    bg = bg
  )
}

cat("Project root: ", project_root,  "\n")
cat("Molecular dir:", molecular_dir, "\n")

# ── Cover variable names (long labels for plotting) ──────────────────────────
cover_vars <- c(
  "Total_lichen_cover",
  "Moss_cover",
  "Crust_cover",
  "Forb_cover",
  "Gaminoid_cover",
  "Bare_Soil_Total",
  "Stones"
)

cover_labels <- c(
  Total_lichen_cover = "Lichen cover (%)",
  Moss_cover         = "Moss cover (%)",
  Crust_cover        = "Soil crust cover (%)",
  Forb_cover         = "Forb cover (%)",
  Gaminoid_cover     = "Graminoid cover (%)",
  Bare_Soil_Total    = "Bare soil (%)",
  Stones             = "Stone cover (%)"
)

moraine_labels <- c(A = "Young (A)", B = "Intermediate (B)", C = "Old (C)")
moraine_colours <- c(
  A = "#8C510A", # young — brown
  B = "#A6D96A", # intermediate — light green
  C = "#1B7837"  # old — dark green
)
location_shapes <- c(
  Nubra = 21,      # circle
  Tsomoriri = 24   # triangle
)
alpha <- 0.05
```

## Load metadata

```{r load-metadata}
meta_file <- file.path(project_root, "Glacier_Soil_Topo_merged.xlsx")
stopifnot("Glacier_Soil_Topo_merged.xlsx not found at project root" = file.exists(meta_file))

plot_meta_raw <- read_excel(meta_file)

cat("Rows:", nrow(plot_meta_raw), "| Columns:", ncol(plot_meta_raw), "\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(colnames(plot_meta_raw))
```

## Prepare data

```{r prepare-data}
derive_glacier_id <- function(plot) {
  out <- as.character(plot)
  # Handles IDs such as NUB1-C-1 or Nubra_1_A by dropping moraine/replicate suffixes.
  out <- sub("[-_][ABC][-_][0-9]+$", "", out)
  out <- sub("[-_][ABC]$", "", out)
  out
}

plot_meta <- plot_meta_raw
if (!"GlacierID" %in% names(plot_meta)) {
  plot_meta <- plot_meta %>%
    mutate(GlacierID = derive_glacier_id(Plot))
}

plot_meta <- plot_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Moraine  = factor(Moraine,  levels = c("A", "B", "C"), labels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    Moraine_num = as.integer(Moraine),
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Nubra", "Tsomoriri")),
    GlacierID = factor(GlacierID),
    # Glacier × moraine random intercept (matches molecular analyses)
    Glacier_Moraine = factor(Plot),
    Aspect_sin = sin(Aspect * pi / 180),
    Aspect_cos = cos(Aspect * pi / 180)
  ) %>%
  # Ensure all cover columns are numeric
  mutate(across(all_of(cover_vars), as.numeric))

# Quick preview
plot_meta %>%
  select(Plot, Location, Moraine, all_of(cover_vars)) %>%
  arrange(Location, Moraine) %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "Plot metadata — cover variables") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Descriptive summary

Mean (± SE) cover by moraine age and location.

```{r descriptive-summary}
cover_long <- plot_meta %>%
  select(Plot, Location, Moraine, Glacier_Moraine, all_of(cover_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(cover_vars),
    names_to  = "cover_type",
    values_to = "pct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cover_type = factor(cover_type, levels = cover_vars),
    cover_label = cover_labels[as.character(cover_type)]
  )

cover_summary <- cover_long %>%
  group_by(cover_type, cover_label, Location, Moraine) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd(pct, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(pct))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cover_summary %>%
  mutate(
    `Mean ± SE` = paste0(round(mean, 1), " ± ", round(se, 1))
  ) %>%
  select(cover_label, Location, Moraine, n, `Mean ± SE`) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Moraine, values_from = c(n, `Mean ± SE`)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Mean (± SE) cover (%) by cover type, location, and moraine age") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Visualisation — cover across chronosequence

```{r cover-violin-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
p_list <- lapply(cover_vars, function(cv) {
  d <- cover_long %>%
    filter(cover_type == cv) %>%
    mutate(Moraine = factor(Moraine, levels = c("A", "B", "C")))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = Moraine, y = pct, fill = Moraine)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.7, colour = NA) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(shape = Location),
      width = 0.08, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75,
      colour = "grey20"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Location) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = moraine_colours) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = location_shapes) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = moraine_labels) +
    labs(
      title = cover_labels[[cv]],
      x     = "Moraine age",
      y     = "Cover (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )
})

wrap_plots(p_list, ncol = 2)
```

## Statistical analysis

Cover data are plot-level measurements (one row per plot), so a random-intercept LMER
is not appropriate. Instead:

- **Moraine effect** — Kruskal-Wallis test (non-parametric; small *n* per group) with
  pairwise Wilcoxon post-hoc and Benjamini–Hochberg FDR across the seven cover types.
- **Location effect** — Wilcoxon rank-sum test (Nubra vs Tsomoriri) with BH-FDR.
- **Environmental drivers** — Spearman *ρ* between each cover type and continuous
  environmental variables; BH-FDR within each cover type.

Environmental variables tested: distance from glacier, elevation, slope, topographic
position index (TPI), aspect (sin/cos), snow cover 1976.

```{r stats-compute}
# ── Environmental variable list ───────────────────────────────────────────────
env_vars <- c(
  "DistanceFromGlacier", "Elevation", "Slope", "TPI",
  "Aspect_sin", "Aspect_cos", "Snow_1976"
)
env_labels <- c(
  DistanceFromGlacier = "Distance from glacier",
  Elevation           = "Elevation (m)",
  Slope               = "Slope (°)",
  TPI                 = "TPI",
  Aspect_sin          = "Aspect (sin)",
  Aspect_cos          = "Aspect (cos)",
  Snow_1976           = "Snow cover 1976"
)

# Coerce env vars to numeric
plot_meta <- plot_meta %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(env_vars), as.numeric))

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "—",
    ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001",
      ifelse(p < 0.01, formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "f"),
        formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "f"))))
}

sig_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
    ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
      ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
        ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""))))
}

# ── 1. Kruskal-Wallis: Moraine effect ────────────────────────────────────────
kw_results <- lapply(cover_vars, function(cv) {
  x <- plot_meta[[cv]]
  g <- plot_meta$Moraine
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(g)
  kt <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(x[ok] ~ g[ok]), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(kt)) return(tibble(cover_type = cv, H = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p_kw = NA_real_))
  tibble(cover_type = cv, H = kt$statistic, df = kt$parameter, p_kw = kt$p.value)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(Padj_kw = p.adjust(p_kw, method = "BH"))

# ── 2. Pairwise Wilcoxon: Moraine post-hoc ───────────────────────────────────
pw_moraine_results <- lapply(cover_vars, function(cv) {
  x <- plot_meta[[cv]]
  g <- plot_meta$Moraine
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(g)
  pw <- tryCatch(
    pairwise.wilcox.test(x[ok], g[ok], p.adjust.method = "none", exact = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(pw)) return(tibble(cover_type = cv, contrast = NA_character_, p_pw = NA_real_))
  pm <- pw$p.value
  pairs_df <- expand.grid(
    g1 = rownames(pm), g2 = colnames(pm), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(pm[cbind(g1, g2)])) %>%
    mutate(
      cover_type = cv,
      contrast   = paste(g1, g2, sep = "-"),
      p_pw       = pm[cbind(g1, g2)]
    ) %>%
    select(cover_type, contrast, p_pw)
  pairs_df
}) %>% bind_rows()

# CLD letters from pairwise Wilcoxon (unadjusted p)
cld_moraine <- lapply(cover_vars, function(cv) {
  pw <- pw_moraine_results %>% filter(cover_type == cv, !is.na(p_pw))
  if (!nrow(pw)) return(tibble(cover_type = cv, Moraine = NA_character_, CLD = NA_character_))
  pvals <- setNames(pw$p_pw, pw$contrast)
  ml <- tryCatch(
    multcompView::multcompLetters(pvals, threshold = alpha),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(ml)) return(tibble(cover_type = cv, Moraine = NA_character_, CLD = NA_character_))
  tibble(cover_type = cv, Moraine = names(ml$Letters), CLD = trimws(unname(ml$Letters)))
}) %>% bind_rows()

# ── 3. Wilcoxon: Location effect ─────────────────────────────────────────────
loc_results <- lapply(cover_vars, function(cv) {
  x <- plot_meta[[cv]]
  g <- plot_meta$Location
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(g) & length(unique(g[!is.na(g)])) == 2
  wt <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(x[ok] ~ g[ok], exact = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(wt)) return(tibble(cover_type = cv, W = NA_real_, p_loc = NA_real_))
  tibble(cover_type = cv, W = wt$statistic, p_loc = wt$p.value)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(Padj_loc = p.adjust(p_loc, method = "BH"))

# ── 4. Spearman correlations: env drivers ────────────────────────────────────
spearman_results <- bind_rows(lapply(cover_vars, function(cv) {
  bind_rows(lapply(env_vars, function(ev) {
    x <- as.numeric(plot_meta[[cv]])
    y <- as.numeric(plot_meta[[ev]])
    ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
    if (sum(ok) < 5) return(tibble(cover_type = cv, env_var = ev, rho = NA_real_, p_sp = NA_real_))
    ct <- tryCatch(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(ct)) return(tibble(cover_type = cv, env_var = ev, rho = NA_real_, p_sp = NA_real_))
    tibble(cover_type = cv, env_var = ev, rho = ct$estimate, p_sp = ct$p.value)
  }))
})) %>%
  group_by(cover_type) %>%
  mutate(Padj_sp = p.adjust(p_sp, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Summary table — moraine & location effects

Kruskal-Wallis H (Moraine) and Wilcoxon W (Location), with BH-FDR across seven cover
types. Group means shown for each moraine age; CLD letters (unadjusted pairwise Wilcoxon,
α = 0.05) indicate significant differences.

```{r summary-table-moraine}
# Group means per moraine
moraine_means <- cover_long %>%
  group_by(cover_type, Moraine) %>%
  summarise(mean_pct = round(mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Moraine, values_from = mean_pct,
              names_prefix = "Mean_")

# Join CLD letters
cld_wide <- cld_moraine %>%
  filter(!is.na(Moraine)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Moraine, values_from = CLD, names_prefix = "CLD_")

# Assemble summary
summary_moraine <- kw_results %>%
  left_join(loc_results %>% select(cover_type, W, p_loc, Padj_loc), by = "cover_type") %>%
  left_join(moraine_means, by = "cover_type") %>%
  left_join(cld_wide,      by = "cover_type") %>%
  mutate(
    cover_label = cover_labels[cover_type],
    # Combine mean + letter into single cell
    `Young (A)`        = paste0(Mean_A, if_else(!is.na(CLD_A), paste0(" ", CLD_A), "")),
    `Intermediate (B)` = paste0(Mean_B, if_else(!is.na(CLD_B), paste0(" ", CLD_B), "")),
    `Old (C)`          = paste0(Mean_C, if_else(!is.na(CLD_C), paste0(" ", CLD_C), "")),
    KW_H    = round(H, 2),
    KW_Padj = fmt_p(Padj_kw),
    KW_sig  = sig_stars(Padj_kw),
    Loc_W   = round(W, 1),
    Loc_Padj = fmt_p(Padj_loc),
    Loc_sig  = sig_stars(Padj_loc)
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Cover type` = cover_label,
    `Young (A)`, `Intermediate (B)`, `Old (C)`,
    `KW H` = KW_H, `KW Padj` = KW_Padj, ` ` = KW_sig,
    `W` = Loc_W, `Loc Padj` = Loc_Padj, `  ` = Loc_sig
  )

summary_moraine %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste0(
      "Mean cover (%) by moraine age with compact-letter display (CLD, unadjusted Wilcoxon α = 0.05). ",
      "KW = Kruskal-Wallis H statistic (Moraine effect, BH-FDR). ",
      "W = Wilcoxon rank-sum statistic (Nubra vs Tsomoriri, BH-FDR). ",
      "*** p < 0.001, ** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05."
    ),
    escape = FALSE, align = "lrrrrrrrrrr"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Mean cover (%) + CLD" = 3,
                     "Moraine (KW)" = 3, "Location (Wilcoxon)" = 3)) %>%
  column_spec(7, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(10, bold = TRUE)
```

## Summary table — environmental drivers (Spearman *ρ*)

Spearman correlation between each cover type and continuous environmental variables.
BH-FDR within cover type across seven environmental variables.
Values shown as *ρ* (FDR-adjusted *p*); bold = significant (Padj < 0.05).

```{r summary-table-env}
# Build wide table: one column per env var, cell = "ρ stars (Padj)"
env_wide <- spearman_results %>%
  mutate(
    cover_label = cover_labels[cover_type],
    env_label   = env_labels[env_var],
    cell = case_when(
      is.na(rho) ~ "—",
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        formatC(rho, digits = 2, format = "f"),
        sig_stars(Padj_sp),
        " (", fmt_p(Padj_sp), ")"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(cover_label, env_label, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = env_label, values_from = cell)

env_wide %>%
  rename(`Cover type` = cover_label) %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste0(
      "Spearman \u03c1 with BH-FDR adjusted p in parentheses. ",
      "Stars: *** p<0.001, ** p<0.01, * p<0.05."
    ),
    escape = TRUE, align = "lrrrrrrr"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(env_wide$cover_label %in% cover_labels[
      spearman_results %>%
        filter(Padj_sp < alpha) %>%
        pull(cover_type) %>%
        unique()
    ]),
    background = "#f0f7ff"
  )
```

## Pairwise Wilcoxon — significant moraine contrasts

Full pairwise tables for cover types with significant Kruskal-Wallis (Padj < 0.05).

```{r pairwise-detail, results='asis'}
sig_kw <- kw_results %>% filter(Padj_kw < alpha) %>% pull(cover_type)

for (cv in sig_kw) {
  lbl <- cover_labels[[cv]]
  pw  <- pw_moraine_results %>%
    filter(cover_type == cv, !is.na(p_pw)) %>%
    mutate(Padj = p.adjust(p_pw, method = "BH"),
           Sig  = sig_stars(Padj)) %>%
    select(Contrast = contrast, `p (unadj)` = p_pw, `Padj (BH)` = Padj, ` ` = Sig) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

  cat(
    pw %>%
      kable(format = "html",
            caption = paste0(lbl, " — pairwise Wilcoxon by moraine age"),
            escape = FALSE) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
      as.character(),
    "\n\n"
  )
}
```

## Cover change along the glacier retreat gradient

Cover variables scaled 0–1 (each variable divided by its within-`GlacierID` maximum) and plotted
against distance from glacier. Point shape indicates location (Nubra = circle;
Tsomoriri = triangle), while fill indicates moraine age (young = brown,
intermediate = light green, old = dark green). Trend line = linear fit ± 95% CI
across both locations combined. Spearman *ρ* and FDR-adjusted *p* (from the table
above) are annotated on each panel; the straight line is a visual summary of trend
direction rather than a separate inferential test.

```{r cover-distance-plots, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 14}
# ── Scale each cover variable 0-1 by the within-GlacierID maximum ─────────────
cover_scaled <- plot_meta %>%
  select(Plot, GlacierID, Location, Moraine, Moraine_num, DistanceFromGlacier, all_of(cover_vars)) %>%
  group_by(GlacierID) %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(cover_vars),
    ~ {
      mx <- max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (is.na(mx) || mx == 0) NA_real_ else .x / mx
    }
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(cover_vars),
    names_to  = "cover_type",
    values_to = "scaled_cover"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cover_label = cover_labels[cover_type],
    cover_label = factor(cover_label, levels = cover_labels),
    Moraine     = factor(Moraine, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    Location    = factor(Location)
  )

# Pull Spearman annotation per cover type
sp_annot <- spearman_results %>%
  filter(env_var == "DistanceFromGlacier") %>%
  mutate(
    cover_label = cover_labels[cover_type],
    cover_label = factor(cover_label, levels = cover_labels),
    label = paste0(
      "\u03c1 = ", formatC(rho, digits = 2, format = "f"),
      sig_stars(Padj_sp),
      "\nPadj = ", fmt_p(Padj_sp)
    )
  )

p_cover_distance <- ggplot(cover_scaled, aes(x = DistanceFromGlacier, y = scaled_cover)) +
  # Linear trend across both locations combined
  geom_smooth(
    method  = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
    colour  = "grey30", fill = "grey80", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.3,
    na.rm   = TRUE
  ) +
  # Points coloured by moraine age, shaped by location
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Moraine, shape = Location),
    size = 3, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # Spearman annotation (top-left of each facet)
  geom_text(
    data  = sp_annot,
    aes(label = label),
    x     = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.3,
    size  = 3, colour = "grey20", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cover_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = moraine_colours, name = "Moraine age",
    labels = moraine_labels
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = location_shapes, name = "Location") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 3.5)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60", size = 3.5))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from glacier (m)",
    y = "Scaled cover (proportion of GlacierID maximum)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.box        = "horizontal",
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank()
  )

p_cover_distance
```

### Cover change along the glacier retreat gradient — raw values

Same distance-gradient plot as above, but using raw cover percentages rather than
within-`GlacierID` scaled values.

```{r cover-distance-raw-plots, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 14}
cover_raw_distance <- plot_meta %>%
  select(Plot, Location, Moraine, DistanceFromGlacier, all_of(cover_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(cover_vars),
    names_to  = "cover_type",
    values_to = "cover_pct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cover_label = cover_labels[cover_type],
    cover_label = factor(cover_label, levels = cover_labels),
    Moraine     = factor(Moraine, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    Location    = factor(Location)
  )

p_cover_distance_raw <- ggplot(cover_raw_distance, aes(x = DistanceFromGlacier, y = cover_pct)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method  = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
    colour  = "grey30", fill = "grey80", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.3,
    na.rm   = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Moraine, shape = Location),
    size = 3, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data  = sp_annot,
    aes(label = label),
    x     = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.3,
    size  = 3, colour = "grey20", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cover_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = moraine_colours, name = "Moraine age",
    labels = moraine_labels
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = location_shapes, name = "Location") +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 3.5)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60", size = 3.5))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from glacier (m)",
```

### Cover change along ordinal moraine age

Same scaled cover values as above, but plotted against moraine age treated as an
ordinal numeric gradient (`Young/A = 1`, `Intermediate/B = 2`, `Old/C = 3`).

```{r cover-moraine-age-plots, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 14}
cover_moraine_sp <- cover_scaled %>%
  group_by(cover_type, cover_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    ok <- complete.cases(.x$Moraine_num, .x$scaled_cover)
    if (sum(ok) < 5) {
      return(tibble(rho = NA_real_, p_sp = NA_real_))
    }
    ct <- cor.test(
      .x$Moraine_num[ok],
      .x$scaled_cover[ok],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    tibble(rho = unname(ct$estimate), p_sp = ct$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Padj_sp = p.adjust(p_sp, method = "BH"),
    label = paste0(
      "\u03c1 = ", formatC(rho, digits = 2, format = "f"),
      sig_stars(Padj_sp),
      "\nPadj = ", fmt_p(Padj_sp)
    )
  )

p_cover_moraine_age <- ggplot(cover_scaled, aes(x = Moraine_num, y = scaled_cover)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method  = "loess", formula = y ~ x, span = 1.5,
    colour  = "grey30", fill = "grey80", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.3,
    na.rm   = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Moraine, shape = Location),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
    size = 3, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data  = cover_moraine_sp,
    aes(label = label),
    x     = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.3,
    size  = 3, colour = "grey20", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cover_label, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:3,
    labels = c("Young\n(1)", "Intermediate\n(2)", "Old\n(3)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = moraine_colours, name = "Moraine age",
    labels = moraine_labels
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = location_shapes, name = "Location") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 3.5)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60", size = 3.5))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Moraine age class (Young = 1, Intermediate = 2, Old = 3)",
    y = "Scaled cover (proportion of GlacierID maximum)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.box        = "horizontal",
```

## Soil properties along the glacier retreat gradient

Same scaling (0–1 by within-`GlacierID` variable maximum) and plot style as the cover figures above.
Environmental variables: pH, organic matter, texture (>2 mm stones), total N, total P,
and exchangeable cations (Na, Mg, K, Ca).

```{r soil-stats-compute}
soil_vars <- c("pH", "OM%", "texture_>2mm", "TN_%", "TP_%",
               "Na_mg_g", "Mg_mg_g", "K_mg_g", "Ca_mg_g")

soil_labels <- c(
  "pH"           = "pH",
  "OM%"          = "Organic matter (%)",
  "texture_>2mm" = "Coarse texture >2 mm (%)",
  "TN_%"         = "Total N (%)",
  "TP_%"         = "Total P (%)",
  "Na_mg_g"      = "Na (mg/g)",
  "Mg_mg_g"      = "Mg (mg/g)",
  "K_mg_g"       = "K (mg/g)",
  "Ca_mg_g"      = "Ca (mg/g)"
)

# Coerce to numeric (names with special chars can read as character from Excel)
plot_meta <- plot_meta %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(soil_vars), as.numeric))

# ── 1. Kruskal-Wallis: Moraine effect ────────────────────────────────────────
soil_kw <- bind_rows(lapply(soil_vars, function(sv) {
  x  <- plot_meta[[sv]]
  g  <- plot_meta$Moraine
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(g)
  kt <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(x[ok] ~ g[ok]), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(kt)) return(tibble(soil_var = sv, H = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p_kw = NA_real_))
  tibble(soil_var = sv, H = kt$statistic, df = kt$parameter, p_kw = kt$p.value)
})) %>%
  mutate(Padj_kw = p.adjust(p_kw, method = "BH"))

# ── 2. Pairwise Wilcoxon post-hoc (Moraine) ──────────────────────────────────
soil_pw_moraine <- bind_rows(lapply(soil_vars, function(sv) {
  x  <- plot_meta[[sv]]
  g  <- plot_meta$Moraine
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(g)
  pw <- tryCatch(
    pairwise.wilcox.test(x[ok], g[ok], p.adjust.method = "none", exact = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(pw)) return(tibble(soil_var = sv, contrast = NA_character_, p_pw = NA_real_))
  pm <- pw$p.value
  expand.grid(g1 = rownames(pm), g2 = colnames(pm), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(pm[cbind(g1, g2)])) %>%
    mutate(soil_var = sv, contrast = paste(g1, g2, sep = "-"),
           p_pw = pm[cbind(g1, g2)]) %>%
    select(soil_var, contrast, p_pw)
}))

# CLD letters per soil variable
soil_cld_moraine <- bind_rows(lapply(soil_vars, function(sv) {
  pw <- soil_pw_moraine %>% filter(soil_var == sv, !is.na(p_pw))
  if (!nrow(pw)) return(tibble(soil_var = sv, Moraine = NA_character_, CLD = NA_character_))
  pvals <- setNames(pw$p_pw, pw$contrast)
  ml <- tryCatch(
    multcompView::multcompLetters(pvals, threshold = alpha),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(ml)) return(tibble(soil_var = sv, Moraine = NA_character_, CLD = NA_character_))
  tibble(soil_var = sv, Moraine = names(ml$Letters), CLD = trimws(unname(ml$Letters)))
}))

# ── 3. Wilcoxon: Location effect ─────────────────────────────────────────────
soil_loc <- bind_rows(lapply(soil_vars, function(sv) {
  x  <- plot_meta[[sv]]
  g  <- plot_meta$Location
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(g)
  wt <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x[ok] ~ g[ok], exact = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(wt)) return(tibble(soil_var = sv, W = NA_real_, p_loc = NA_real_))
  tibble(soil_var = sv, W = wt$statistic, p_loc = wt$p.value)
})) %>%
  mutate(Padj_loc = p.adjust(p_loc, method = "BH"))

# ── 4. Spearman: all env vars ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
soil_spearman_all <- bind_rows(lapply(soil_vars, function(sv) {
  bind_rows(lapply(env_vars, function(ev) {
    x  <- as.numeric(plot_meta[[ev]])
    y  <- as.numeric(plot_meta[[sv]])
    ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
    if (sum(ok) < 5) return(tibble(soil_var = sv, env_var = ev, rho = NA_real_, p_sp = NA_real_))
    ct <- tryCatch(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(ct)) return(tibble(soil_var = sv, env_var = ev, rho = NA_real_, p_sp = NA_real_))
    tibble(soil_var = sv, env_var = ev, rho = ct$estimate, p_sp = ct$p.value)
  }))
})) %>%
  group_by(soil_var) %>%
  mutate(Padj_sp = p.adjust(p_sp, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# Convenience alias for the distance-from-glacier subset (used by the plot below)
soil_spearman <- soil_spearman_all %>% filter(env_var == "DistanceFromGlacier") %>%
  select(soil_var, rho, p_sp, Padj_sp)
```

### Moraine & location effects — summary table

```{r soil-summary-table}
# Group means per moraine
soil_long <- plot_meta %>%
  select(Plot, Location, Moraine, any_of(soil_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = any_of(soil_vars), names_to = "soil_var", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(Moraine = factor(Moraine, levels = c("A", "B", "C")))

soil_moraine_means <- soil_long %>%
  group_by(soil_var, Moraine) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = round(mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Moraine, values_from = mean_val, names_prefix = "Mean_")

soil_cld_wide <- soil_cld_moraine %>%
  filter(!is.na(Moraine)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Moraine, values_from = CLD, names_prefix = "CLD_")

soil_summary <- soil_kw %>%
  left_join(soil_loc %>% select(soil_var, W, p_loc, Padj_loc), by = "soil_var") %>%
  left_join(soil_moraine_means,  by = "soil_var") %>%
  left_join(soil_cld_wide,       by = "soil_var") %>%
  mutate(
    soil_label = soil_labels[soil_var],
    `Young (A)`        = paste0(Mean_A, if_else(!is.na(CLD_A), paste0(" ", CLD_A), "")),
    `Intermediate (B)` = paste0(Mean_B, if_else(!is.na(CLD_B), paste0(" ", CLD_B), "")),
    `Old (C)`          = paste0(Mean_C, if_else(!is.na(CLD_C), paste0(" ", CLD_C), "")),
    KW_H     = round(H, 2),
    KW_Padj  = fmt_p(Padj_kw),
    KW_sig   = sig_stars(Padj_kw),
    Loc_W    = round(W, 1),
    Loc_Padj = fmt_p(Padj_loc),
    Loc_sig  = sig_stars(Padj_loc)
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Soil property` = soil_label,
    `Young (A)`, `Intermediate (B)`, `Old (C)`,
    `KW H` = KW_H, `KW Padj` = KW_Padj, ` ` = KW_sig,
    `W` = Loc_W, `Loc Padj` = Loc_Padj, `  ` = Loc_sig
  )

soil_summary %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste0(
      "Mean soil property by moraine age with compact-letter display ",
      "(CLD, unadjusted pairwise Wilcoxon, \u03b1 = 0.05). ",
      "KW = Kruskal-Wallis H (Moraine, BH-FDR). ",
      "W = Wilcoxon rank-sum (Nubra vs Tsomoriri, BH-FDR). ",
      "*** p<0.001, ** p<0.01, * p<0.05."
    ),
    escape = FALSE, align = "lrrrrrrrrrr"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Mean value + CLD" = 3,
                     "Moraine (KW)" = 3, "Location (Wilcoxon)" = 3)) %>%
  column_spec(7, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(10, bold = TRUE)
```

### Environmental drivers — Spearman *ρ* table

```{r soil-env-table}
soil_env_wide <- soil_spearman_all %>%
  mutate(
    soil_label = soil_labels[soil_var],
    soil_label = factor(soil_label, levels = soil_labels),
    env_label  = env_labels[env_var],
    cell = case_when(
      is.na(rho) ~ "—",
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        formatC(rho, digits = 2, format = "f"),
        sig_stars(Padj_sp),
        " (", fmt_p(Padj_sp), ")"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(soil_label, env_label, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = env_label, values_from = cell)

soil_env_wide %>%
  rename(`Soil property` = soil_label) %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste0(
      "Spearman \u03c1 (BH-FDR adjusted p) — soil properties vs environmental variables. ",
      "Stars: *** p<0.001, ** p<0.01, * p<0.05."
    ),
    escape = TRUE, align = "lrrrrrrr"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

### Pairwise Wilcoxon — significant moraine contrasts

```{r soil-pairwise-detail, results='asis'}
sig_soil_kw <- soil_kw %>% filter(Padj_kw < alpha) %>% pull(soil_var)

for (sv in sig_soil_kw) {
  lbl <- soil_labels[[sv]]
  pw  <- soil_pw_moraine %>%
    filter(soil_var == sv, !is.na(p_pw)) %>%
    mutate(Padj = p.adjust(p_pw, method = "BH"),
           Sig  = sig_stars(Padj)) %>%
    select(Contrast = contrast, `p (unadj)` = p_pw, `Padj (BH)` = Padj, ` ` = Sig) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
  cat(
    pw %>%
      kable(format = "html",
            caption = paste0(lbl, " — pairwise Wilcoxon by moraine age"),
            escape = FALSE) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
      as.character(),
    "\n\n"
  )
}
```

```{r soil-distance-plots, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 16}
# Scale each soil variable 0-1 by the within-GlacierID maximum
soil_scaled <- plot_meta %>%
  select(Plot, GlacierID, Location, Moraine, Moraine_num, DistanceFromGlacier, any_of(soil_vars)) %>%
  group_by(GlacierID) %>%
  mutate(across(
    any_of(soil_vars),
    ~ {
      mx <- max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (is.na(mx) || mx == 0) NA_real_ else .x / mx
    }

  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = any_of(soil_vars),

    Location   = factor(Location)

# Spearman annotation per panel

    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 3.5)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60", size = 3.5))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from glacier (m)",
    y = "Scaled value (proportion of GlacierID maximum)"

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
```

```{r export-cover-soil-smoothed-figures, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
export_cover_soil_figure <- function(name, fig) {
  png_file <- file.path(cover_fig_dir, paste0(name, "_REVISION.png"))
  svg_file <- file.path(cover_fig_dir, paste0(name, "_REVISION.svg"))

  ggsave(
    filename = png_file,
    plot = fig$plot,
    width = fig$width,
    height = fig$height,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  save_gg_svg(
    filename = svg_file,
    plot = fig$plot,
    width = fig$width,
    height = fig$height
  )

  tibble(
    figure = name,
    description = fig$description,
    png = png_file,
    svg = svg_file
  )
}
```

## Cover × soil relationships

Spearman *ρ* between every cover type and every soil property. BH-FDR correction applied
across all 63 pairs (7 cover × 9 soil). A heatmap shows the full correlation matrix;
scatter plots are produced for all pairs with Padj < 0.05.

```{r cover-soil-correlations}
# ── Full cover × soil Spearman matrix ────────────────────────────────────────
cover_soil_cor <- bind_rows(lapply(cover_vars, function(cv) {
  bind_rows(lapply(soil_vars, function(sv) {
    x  <- as.numeric(plot_meta[[cv]])
    y  <- as.numeric(plot_meta[[sv]])
    ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
    if (sum(ok) < 5) {
      return(tibble(cover_var = cv, soil_var = sv, rho = NA_real_, p_sp = NA_real_))
    }
    ct <- tryCatch(
      cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(ct)) {
      return(tibble(cover_var = cv, soil_var = sv, rho = NA_real_, p_sp = NA_real_))
    }
    tibble(cover_var = cv, soil_var = sv, rho = ct$estimate, p_sp = ct$p.value)
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(Padj = p.adjust(p_sp, method = "BH"))

# Significant pairs
sig_pairs <- cover_soil_cor %>% filter(!is.na(Padj), Padj < alpha)
cat(nrow(sig_pairs), "significant cover × soil pairs (Padj <", alpha, ")\n")

# Numeric summary table
cover_soil_cor %>%
  mutate(
    cover_label = cover_labels[cover_var],
    soil_label  = soil_labels[soil_var],
    cell = paste0(
      formatC(rho, digits = 2, format = "f"),
      sig_stars(Padj),
      " (", fmt_p(Padj), ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(cover_label, soil_label, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = soil_label, values_from = cell) %>%
  rename(`Cover type` = cover_label) %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste0(
      "Spearman \u03c1 (BH-FDR p) — cover types vs soil properties ",
      "(FDR across all 63 pairs). Stars: *** p<0.001, ** p<0.01, * p<0.05."
    ),
    escape = TRUE, align = "lrrrrrrrrr"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r cover-soil-heatmap, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
    soil_label  = factor(soil_labels[soil_var],   levels = soil_labels),
    sig_label   = case_when(
```

## Spearman correlation heatmaps — cover, soil, and environment

Three cross-block Spearman heatmaps:

1. **Cover × soil**
2. **Cover × topography / environmental** (distance, moraine age, elevation, slope, TPI, aspect, snow)
3. **Soil × topography / environmental**

Benjamini–Hochberg FDR is applied **within each heatmap** (across that block's unique pairs).

```{r cross-block-spearman-setup}
env_corr_vars <- c(
  "DistanceFromGlacier",
  "Moraine_num",
  setdiff(env_vars, "DistanceFromGlacier")
)

env_corr_labels <- c(
  DistanceFromGlacier = env_labels[["DistanceFromGlacier"]],
  Moraine_num         = "Moraine age (Young=1, Old=3)",
  env_labels[setdiff(env_vars, "DistanceFromGlacier")]
)

compute_cross_spearman <- function(df, vars_row, vars_col) {
  bind_rows(lapply(vars_row, function(v_row) {
    bind_rows(lapply(vars_col, function(v_col) {
      x <- as.numeric(df[[v_row]])
      y <- as.numeric(df[[v_col]])
      ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
      if (sum(ok) < 5L) {
        return(tibble(
          var_row = v_row,
          var_col = v_col,
          rho = NA_real_,
          p_sp = NA_real_
        ))
      }
      ct <- tryCatch(
        cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(ct)) {
        return(tibble(
          var_row = v_row,
          var_col = v_col,
          rho = NA_real_,
          p_sp = NA_real_
        ))
      }
      tibble(
        var_row = v_row,
        var_col = v_col,
        rho = unname(ct$estimate),
        p_sp = ct$p.value
      )
    }))
  })) %>%
    mutate(Padj = p.adjust(p_sp, method = "BH"))
}

annotate_cross_cor <- function(cor_df, vars_row, vars_col, row_labels, col_labels) {
  cor_df %>%
    mutate(
      row_label = factor(
        unname(row_labels[var_row]),
        levels = rev(unname(row_labels[vars_row]))
      ),
      col_label = factor(
        unname(col_labels[var_col]),
        levels = unname(col_labels[vars_col])
      ),
      sig_label = case_when(
        is.na(Padj)  ~ "",
        Padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        Padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        Padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE         ~ ""
      )
    )
}

make_cross_spearman_heatmap <- function(
    hm_df,
    title,
    subtitle,
    x_lab = NULL,
    y_lab = NULL
) {
  ggplot(hm_df, aes(x = col_label, y = row_label, fill = rho)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 3.5, vjust = 0.8, colour = "grey10") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#d73027",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#1a9850",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      name = "Spearman \u03c1",
      na.value = "grey95"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_lab,
      y = y_lab,
      caption = "Stars: *** Padj < 0.001, ** Padj < 0.01, * Padj < 0.05 (BH-FDR within heatmap)."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 0, size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

cover_soil_cor_block <- compute_cross_spearman(plot_meta, cover_vars, soil_vars) %>%
  annotate_cross_cor(cover_vars, soil_vars, cover_labels, soil_labels)

cover_env_cor_block <- compute_cross_spearman(plot_meta, cover_vars, env_corr_vars) %>%
  annotate_cross_cor(cover_vars, env_corr_vars, cover_labels, env_corr_labels)

soil_env_cor_block <- compute_cross_spearman(plot_meta, soil_vars, env_corr_vars) %>%
  annotate_cross_cor(soil_vars, env_corr_vars, soil_labels, env_corr_labels)

cross_block_cor_all <- bind_rows(
  cover_soil_cor_block %>% mutate(block = "Cover x Soil"),
  cover_env_cor_block %>% mutate(block = "Cover x Environment"),
  soil_env_cor_block %>% mutate(block = "Soil x Environment")
) %>%
  mutate(
    row_label = case_when(
      block == "Cover x Soil" ~ cover_labels[var_row],
      block == "Cover x Environment" ~ cover_labels[var_row],
      block == "Soil x Environment" ~ soil_labels[var_row]
    ),
    col_label = case_when(
      block == "Cover x Soil" ~ soil_labels[var_col],
      block == "Cover x Environment" ~ env_corr_labels[var_col],
      block == "Soil x Environment" ~ env_corr_labels[var_col]
    ),
    sig_label = case_when(
      is.na(Padj)  ~ "",
      Padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      Padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      Padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE         ~ ""
    )
  )

cat("Cover x soil pairs:", nrow(cover_soil_cor_block),
    "| sig:", sum(cover_soil_cor_block$Padj < alpha, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Cover x environment pairs:", nrow(cover_env_cor_block),
    "| sig:", sum(cover_env_cor_block$Padj < alpha, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Soil x environment pairs:", nrow(soil_env_cor_block),
    "| sig:", sum(soil_env_cor_block$Padj < alpha, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## Structural equation model — environment → colonization → soil

A path model testing the directional chain:
**environmental gradient → vegetation colonization → soil development**.

With ~20–30 plots, individual-variable SEM is parameter-saturated. Instead:

1. **PCA on cover variables** → PC1 scores as a *vegetation colonisation index*
   (loadings show which cover types load positively).
2. **PCA on soil variables** → PC1 scores as a *soil development index*.
3. **`lavaan` path model** (all variables standardised):

```
Distance, Elevation, Snow → VegPC1 → SoilPC1
                          ↘ direct ↗
```

Standardised path coefficients, *p*-values, and bootstrapped indirect effects are
reported. Fisher's C test (from a `piecewiseSEM` cross-check) assesses model fit.

```{r sem-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(lavaan)
  library(piecewiseSEM)
})

# ── Clean variable names for formula use ─────────────────────────────────────
sem_raw <- plot_meta %>%
  rename(
    OM_pct       = `OM%`,
    TN_pct       = `TN_%`,
    TP_pct       = `TP_%`,
    Texture_2mm  = `texture_>2mm`
  ) %>%
  select(
    Plot, Location, Moraine,
    DistanceFromGlacier, Elevation, Slope, TPI, Aspect_sin, Aspect_cos, Snow_1976,
    all_of(cover_vars),
    OM_pct, pH, TN_pct, TP_pct, Na_mg_g, Mg_mg_g, K_mg_g, Ca_mg_g, Texture_2mm
  ) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

cat("n plots (complete cases):", nrow(sem_raw), "\n")

# ── PCA — cover (vegetation colonisation index) ───────────────────────────────
cover_mat <- sem_raw %>%
  select(all_of(cover_vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

pca_cover <- prcomp(cover_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

cat("\nCover PCA — variance explained:\n")
print(round(summary(pca_cover)$importance[, 1:4], 3))
cat("\nCover PC1 loadings:\n")
print(round(pca_cover$rotation[, 1], 3))

# ── PCA — soil (soil development index) ──────────────────────────────────────
soil_mat <- sem_raw %>%
  select(OM_pct, pH, TN_pct, TP_pct, Na_mg_g, Mg_mg_g, K_mg_g, Ca_mg_g, Texture_2mm) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

pca_soil <- prcomp(soil_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

cat("\nSoil PCA — variance explained:\n")
print(round(summary(pca_soil)$importance[, 1:4], 3))
cat("\nSoil PC1 loadings:\n")
print(round(pca_soil$rotation[, 1], 3))

# ── PCA — topography (all env except Distance) ────────────────────────────────
# Snow_1976 is binary (0/1) but included as numeric for PCA; interpretable as
# "recently glaciated" axis combined with terrain shape variables.
topo_vars_pca <- c("Elevation", "Slope", "TPI", "Aspect_sin", "Aspect_cos", "Snow_1976")

topo_mat <- sem_raw %>%
  select(all_of(topo_vars_pca)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

pca_topo <- prcomp(topo_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

cat("\nTopography PCA — variance explained:\n")
print(round(summary(pca_topo)$importance[, 1:4], 3))
cat("\nTopography PC1 loadings:\n")
print(round(pca_topo$rotation[, 1], 3))

# ── Microbial genus richness — rarefied, plot-level ───────────────────────────
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(vegan)
  library(NetCoMi)
})

# ── Helper: resolve RDS path ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
pick_existing_file <- function(candidates, label = "file") {
  hits <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(hits) == 0)
    stop("Could not find ", label, ". Tried:\n",
         paste0("  - ", candidates, collapse = "\n"))
  normalizePath(hits[[1]], winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}

# ── Load and glom to genus ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
load_genus_ps <- function(rds_candidates, label) {
  ps_raw <- readRDS(pick_existing_file(rds_candidates, label))
  ps_g   <- phyloseq::tax_glom(ps_raw, taxrank = "Genus")
  ps_g   <- NetCoMi::renameTaxa(
    ps_g,
    pat      = "<name>",
    substPat = "<name>_<subst_name>(<subst_R>)",
    numDupli = "Genus"
  )
  ps_g
}

ps_16s_genus <- load_genus_ps(
  c(file.path(molecular_dir, "ITS", "La_Gla_final_16S_core.Rds"),
    file.path(molecular_dir, "La_Gla_final_16S_core.Rds")),
  "16S core phyloseq"
)

ps_its_genus <- load_genus_ps(
  c(file.path(molecular_dir, "ITS", "La_Gla_final_ITS_core.Rds"),
    file.path(molecular_dir, "La_Gla_final_ITS_core.Rds")),
  "ITS core phyloseq"
)

# ── Pool samples to plot level, then rarefy iteratively ───────────────────────
# n_iter rarefaction draws are averaged to remove stochastic noise from a
# single subsample draw.  Both observed genus richness and Shannon H' are
# averaged across iterations.
pool_and_rarefy <- function(ps, plot_col = "Plot", n_iter = 999, seed = 42) {
  otu  <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)   # rows = samples
  meta <- as(phyloseq::sample_data(ps), "data.frame")

  stopifnot(plot_col %in% colnames(meta))

  plots     <- as.character(meta[[plot_col]])
  pool      <- rowsum(otu, group = plots)     # sum counts per plot
  depth     <- rowSums(pool)
  min_depth <- min(depth)
  cat("  Pooled reads — min:", min_depth,
      " | median:", round(median(depth)),
      " | n plots:", nrow(pool), "\n")

  pool_ok <- pool[depth >= min_depth, , drop = FALSE]

  set.seed(seed)
  rich_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(pool_ok), ncol = n_iter)
  shan_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(pool_ok), ncol = n_iter)

  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    rare_i          <- vegan::rrarefy(pool_ok, sample = min_depth)
    rich_mat[, i]   <- rowSums(rare_i > 0)
    shan_mat[, i]   <- vegan::diversity(rare_i, index = "shannon")
  }

  tibble(
    Plot     = rownames(pool_ok),
    n_genera = rowMeans(rich_mat),        # mean observed genus richness
    shannon  = rowMeans(shan_mat)         # mean Shannon H'
  )
}

cat("Pooling 16S to plot level — iterative rarefaction (999 draws) ...\n")
div_16s <- pool_and_rarefy(ps_16s_genus) %>%
  rename(Rich_16S = n_genera, Shan_16S = shannon)

cat("Pooling ITS to plot level — iterative rarefaction (999 draws) ...\n")
div_its <- pool_and_rarefy(ps_its_genus) %>%
  rename(Rich_ITS = n_genera, Shan_ITS = shannon)

rich_raw <- full_join(div_16s, div_its, by = "Plot")

cat("\nDiversity summary (999-draw average):\n")
cat("16S — median richness:", round(median(rich_raw$Rich_16S, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    " | median Shannon:", round(median(rich_raw$Shan_16S, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("ITS — median richness:", round(median(rich_raw$Rich_ITS, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    " | median Shannon:", round(median(rich_raw$Shan_ITS, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
print(rich_raw)
```

```{r sem-pca-biplots, fig.width=13, fig.height=4.5}
# ── Generic biplot helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
biplot_df <- function(pca_obj, score_df) {
  scores   <- as.data.frame(pca_obj$x[, 1:2])
  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_obj$rotation[, 1:2])
  loadings$Variable <- rownames(loadings)
  list(scores = bind_cols(score_df, scores), loadings = loadings)
}

make_biplot <- function(bp, pca_obj, title, var_labels = NULL, scale = 2.5) {
  pct <- round(summary(pca_obj)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)
  labs_fn <- function(v) if (!is.null(var_labels) && v %in% names(var_labels)) var_labels[v] else v

  ggplot(bp$scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Moraine, shape = Location),
               size = 3, colour = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = bp$loadings,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * scale, yend = PC2 * scale),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.18, "cm")),
                 colour = "#c0392b", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_text(data = bp$loadings %>%
                mutate(lbl = sapply(Variable, labs_fn)),
              aes(x = PC1 * (scale + 0.3), y = PC2 * (scale + 0.3), label = lbl),
              size = 2.8, colour = "#c0392b", fontface = "italic") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = moraine_colours,
      labels = moraine_labels,
      name = "Moraine age"
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = location_shapes, name = "Location") +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60"))
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0(title, " PCA"),
         x = paste0("PC1 (", pct[1], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", pct[2], "%)")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

cover_bp <- biplot_df(pca_cover, sem_raw %>% select(Location, Moraine))
soil_bp  <- biplot_df(pca_soil,  sem_raw %>% select(Location, Moraine))
topo_bp  <- biplot_df(pca_topo,  sem_raw %>% select(Location, Moraine))

cover_var_labels <- setNames(
  c("Lichen","Moss","Crust","Forb","Graminoid","Bare soil","Stones"), cover_vars
)
soil_var_labels <- c(
  OM_pct = "OM%", pH = "pH", TN_pct = "TN%", TP_pct = "TP%",
  Na_mg_g = "Na", Mg_mg_g = "Mg", K_mg_g = "K", Ca_mg_g = "Ca",
  Texture_2mm = ">2mm"
)
topo_var_labels <- c(
  Elevation  = "Elevation", Slope   = "Slope", TPI       = "TPI",
  Aspect_sin = "Asp.(sin)", Aspect_cos = "Asp.(cos)", Snow_1976 = "Snow 1976"
)

make_biplot(cover_bp, pca_cover, "Cover",       cover_var_labels) +
make_biplot(soil_bp,  pca_soil,  "Soil",        soil_var_labels) +
make_biplot(topo_bp,  pca_topo,  "Topography",  topo_var_labels) +
plot_layout(guides = "collect", ncol = 3) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### PCA conditioned by location

The same three PCAs repeated separately for **Nubra** and **Tsomoriri** to check
whether the dominant axes of variation are consistent across locations or driven
by location-specific gradients.

```{r sem-pca-biplots-location, fig.width=13, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
# ── Run all three PCAs within each location ───────────────────────────────────
locations <- unique(sem_raw$Location)

# For each location, compute PCAs and collect biplots
pca_vars <- list(
  Cover      = list(vars = cover_vars,    labels = cover_var_labels,  scale = 2.5),
  Soil       = list(vars = c("OM_pct","pH","TN_pct","TP_pct",
                              "Na_mg_g","Mg_mg_g","K_mg_g","Ca_mg_g",
                              "Texture_2mm"),
                    labels = soil_var_labels, scale = 2.5),
  Topography = list(vars = topo_vars_pca, labels = topo_var_labels,   scale = 2.0)
)

loc_plots <- lapply(locations, function(loc) {
  sub <- sem_raw %>% filter(Location == loc)

  lapply(names(pca_vars), function(ptype) {
    cfg     <- pca_vars[[ptype]]
    mat     <- sub %>%
      select(all_of(cfg$vars)) %>%
      mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
      # drop columns with zero variance (can't scale them)
      select(where(~ var(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

    if (ncol(mat) < 2 || nrow(mat) < 3) return(NULL)

    pca_loc <- prcomp(mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
    bp_loc  <- biplot_df(pca_loc, sub %>% select(Location, Moraine))

    make_biplot(bp_loc, pca_loc,
                title      = paste0(ptype, "\n(", loc, ")"),
                var_labels = cfg$labels,
                scale      = cfg$scale) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
  })
})

# Flatten into a list, removing NULLs
plot_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), unlist(loc_plots, recursive = FALSE))

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Partial PCA — variation independent of location

The between-location centroid (Nubra vs Tsomoriri mean) is removed as a
conditioning variable before decomposition: `rda(mat ~ Condition(Location))`.
The resulting axes (`PC1`, `PC2`) capture only the *within-location* covariance
structure — i.e. variation shared by both glacier systems after the location
effect is partialled out. Points are coloured by moraine age; shapes still
distinguish locations so any residual separation can be seen.

```{r sem-pca-partial, fig.width=13, fig.height=4.5, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(vegan))

# ── Partial RDA variance summary helper ───────────────────────────────────────
summarise_partial_rda_variance <- function(mat, meta, input_name) {
  ok_cols <- apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  mat <- mat[, ok_cols, drop = FALSE]

  rda_obj <- vegan::rda(
    mat ~ Condition(Location),
    data = meta,
    scale = TRUE
  )

  total_inertia <- rda_obj$tot.chi
  conditioned_inertia <- if (is.null(rda_obj$pCCA)) {
    0
  } else {
    rda_obj$pCCA$tot.chi
  }
  residual_inertia <- rda_obj$CA$tot.chi

  residual_eigenvalues <- vegan::eigenvals(
    rda_obj,
    model = "unconstrained"
  )
  residual_axis_pct <- residual_eigenvalues /
    sum(residual_eigenvalues) * 100

  tibble(
    PCA_input = input_name,
    n_variables = ncol(mat),
    total_inertia = total_inertia,
    conditioned_inertia = conditioned_inertia,
    variation_conditioned_by_location_pct =
      conditioned_inertia / total_inertia * 100,
    residual_inertia = residual_inertia,
    residual_variation_pct = residual_inertia / total_inertia * 100,
    PC1_pct_of_residual_variation = residual_axis_pct[1],
    PC2_pct_of_residual_variation = residual_axis_pct[2]
  )
}

# ── Partial RDA biplot helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_partial_biplot <- function(mat, meta, title, var_labels = NULL,
                                scale = 2.0) {

  # Drop zero-variance columns
  ok_cols <- apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  mat     <- mat[, ok_cols, drop = FALSE]

  # Partial RDA: condition on Location
  rda_obj <- vegan::rda(mat ~ Condition(Location), data = meta,
                         scale = TRUE)

  # Variance explained by each residual PC
  ev      <- eigenvals(rda_obj, model = "unconstrained")
  pct_ev  <- round(ev / sum(ev) * 100, 1)

  # Site scores (one row per plot)
  sites   <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_obj, display = "sites",
                                   choices = 1:2, scaling = 2))
  sites$Location <- meta$Location
  sites$Moraine  <- meta$Moraine

  # Species loadings
  sp      <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_obj, display = "species",
                                   choices = 1:2, scaling = 2))
  sp$Variable <- rownames(sp)

  labs_fn <- function(v)
    if (!is.null(var_labels) && v %in% names(var_labels)) var_labels[[v]] else v

  ggplot(sites, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Moraine, shape = Location),
               size = 3.5, colour = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = sp,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * scale, yend = PC2 * scale),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.18, "cm")),
                 colour = "#c0392b", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_text(data = sp %>%
                mutate(lbl = sapply(Variable, labs_fn)),
              aes(x = PC1 * (scale + 0.3), y = PC2 * (scale + 0.3),
                  label = lbl),
              size = 2.8, colour = "#c0392b", fontface = "italic") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = moraine_colours,
      labels = moraine_labels,
      name   = "Moraine age"
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = location_shapes, name = "Location") +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60"))
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0(title, "\n(partial PCA | Location conditioned out)"),
         x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_ev[1], "% of residual var.)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_ev[2], "% of residual var.)")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
}

# ── Prepare numeric matrices (same rows as sem_raw) ───────────────────────────
cover_mat_all <- sem_raw %>%
  select(all_of(cover_vars)) %>%

soil_mat_all  <- sem_raw %>%

meta_all <- sem_raw %>% select(Location, Moraine)

partial_pca_variance_summary <- bind_rows(

partial_pca_variance_summary %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        total_inertia,
        conditioned_inertia,
        residual_inertia

      ~ round(.x, 3)
```

```{r sem-fit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Assemble core SEM data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# TopoPC1 = first PC of Elevation, Slope, TPI, Aspect_sin/cos, Snow_1976.
# All composites and continuous env vars are z-scored for comparability.
sem_data <- sem_raw %>%
  mutate(
    VegPC1   = as.numeric(scale(pca_cover$x[, 1])),
    SoilPC1  = as.numeric(scale(pca_soil$x[, 1])),
    TopoPC1  = as.numeric(scale(pca_topo$x[, 1])),
    Dist_z   = as.numeric(scale(DistanceFromGlacier))
  )

# ── Core lavaan path model: Distance + TopoPC1 -> Veg -> Soil ────────────────
sem_model <- '
  # Tier 1: env -> vegetation colonisation
  VegPC1  ~ a1*Dist_z + a2*TopoPC1

  # Tier 2: veg -> soil + direct env effects on soil
  SoilPC1 ~ b*VegPC1 + c1*Dist_z + c2*TopoPC1

  # Indirect effects (env -> veg -> soil)
  ind_dist := a1 * b
  ind_topo := a2 * b

  # Total effects on soil
  tot_dist := a1 * b + c1
  tot_topo := a2 * b + c2
'

sem_fit <- sem(
  sem_model,
  data      = sem_data,
  estimator = "ML",
  se        = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000
)

fit_idx <- fitMeasures(sem_fit, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
cat("Core model fit:\n"); print(round(fit_idx, 3))
cat("\nR-squared:\n"); print(lavInspect(sem_fit, "r2"))
```

```{r sem-tables}
# ── Shared helper: format parameterEstimates into a clean tibble ──────────────
fmt_params <- function(fit) {
  parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, boot.ci.type = "bca.simple") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(op %in% c("~", ":=")) %>%
    mutate(
      Type     = if_else(op == ":=", "Indirect/Total", "Direct"),
      std_beta = round(std.all, 3),
      SE       = round(se,      3),
      CI_lo    = round(ci.lower, 3),
      CI_hi    = round(ci.upper, 3),
      p_val    = round(pvalue,  4),
      Sig      = sig_stars(pvalue)
    )
}

core_labels <- c(
  Dist_z  = "Distance from glacier (z)",
  TopoPC1 = "Topo. PCA1 (z)",
  VegPC1  = "Veg. colonisation PC1",
  SoilPC1 = "Soil development PC1"
)
ind_labels_core <- c(
  ind_dist = "Distance -> Veg -> Soil (indirect)",
  ind_topo = "TopoPC1  -> Veg -> Soil (indirect)",
  tot_dist = "Distance -> Soil (total)",
  tot_topo = "TopoPC1  -> Soil (total)"
)

param_core <- fmt_params(sem_fit)

# Direct paths
direct_core <- param_core %>%
  filter(Type == "Direct") %>%
  mutate(
    Response  = dplyr::recode(rhs, !!!core_labels),
    Predictor = dplyr::recode(lhs, !!!core_labels)
  ) %>%
  select(Response, Predictor, `Beta (std)` = std_beta, SE,
         `95% CI lo` = CI_lo, `95% CI hi` = CI_hi, p = p_val, ` ` = Sig)

nv <- sum(direct_core$Response == core_labels["VegPC1"])
ns <- sum(direct_core$Response == core_labels["SoilPC1"])

direct_core %>%
  kable(caption = paste0(
    "Core SEM direct paths (std. beta; 1000-rep bootstrap BCA CI). ",
    "TopoPC1 = PC1 of Elevation, Slope, TPI, Aspect sin/cos, Snow 1976 (all z-scored)."
  )) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows("-> Veg. colonisation PC1", 1,      nv) %>%
  pack_rows("-> Soil development PC1",  nv + 1, nv + ns)

# Indirect & total effects
param_core %>%
  filter(Type == "Indirect/Total") %>%
  mutate(Effect = dplyr::recode(lhs, !!!ind_labels_core)) %>%
  select(Effect, `Beta (std)` = std_beta, SE,
         `95% CI lo` = CI_lo, `95% CI hi` = CI_hi, p = p_val, ` ` = Sig) %>%
  kable(caption = "Core SEM indirect and total effects") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows("Indirect (env -> veg -> soil)", 1, 2) %>%
  pack_rows("Total (direct + indirect)",     3, 4)
```

```{r sem-path-diagram, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5}
paths <- parameterEstimates(sem_fit, standardized = TRUE) %>%
  filter(op == "~") %>%
  mutate(std_beta = round(std.all, 2), sig = pvalue < alpha)

# 4-node layout: 2 env inputs | VegPC1 | SoilPC1
nodes <- tribble(
  ~node,      ~x,    ~y,    ~label,                              ~type,
  "Dist_z",    0.00,  0.72,  "Distance\nfrom glacier (z)",        "env",
  "TopoPC1",   0.00,  0.28,  "Topography\nPC1 (z)",              "env",
  "VegPC1",    0.50,  0.50,  "Vegetation\ncolonisation\n(PC1)",   "composite",
  "SoilPC1",   1.00,  0.50,  "Soil\ndevelopment\n(PC1)",          "composite"
)

draw_sem_diagram <- function(paths_df, nodes_df, node_w = 0.30, node_h = 0.12,
                             txt_size = 3.2, edge_frac = 0.55) {
  if (!"show_label" %in% names(paths_df)) {
    paths_df$show_label <- paths_df$sig
  }
  if (!"label_sig" %in% names(paths_df)) {
    paths_df$label_sig <- paths_df$sig
  }

  edges_df <- paths_df %>%
    left_join(nodes_df %>% select(lhs = node, x0 = x, y0 = y), by = "lhs") %>%
    left_join(nodes_df %>% select(rhs = node, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "rhs") %>%
    filter(!is.na(x0), !is.na(x1)) %>%
    mutate(
      alpha = if_else(sig, 1.0, 0.22),
      lwd   = pmax(abs(std_beta) * 2.8 + 0.3, 0.4),
      lbl_x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * edge_frac,
      lbl_y = y0 + (y1 - y0) * edge_frac,
      lbl   = if_else(show_label, paste0(std_beta, if_else(label_sig, "*", "")), "")
    )

  nfill <- c(env = "#dbeafe", composite = "#fef3c7", outcome = "#d1fae5")
  nbord <- c(env = "#2563eb", composite = "#d97706", outcome = "#059669")
  nodes_c <- nodes_df %>%
    mutate(fill_c = nfill[type], bord_c = nbord[type])

  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = edges_df %>% filter(std_beta >= 0),
      aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, linewidth = lwd, alpha = alpha),
      colour = "#1a9850",
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = edges_df %>% filter(std_beta < 0),
      aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, linewidth = lwd, alpha = alpha),
      colour = "#d73027",
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = edges_df %>% filter(show_label),
      aes(x = lbl_x, y = lbl_y, label = lbl),
      size = txt_size - 0.5, label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"),
      label.size = 0, fill = "white", colour = "grey15"
    ) +
    geom_tile(
      data = nodes_c,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = fill_c, colour = bord_c),
      width = node_w, height = node_h, linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = nodes_c,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      size = txt_size, lineheight = 0.85
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_linewidth_identity() +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    labs(caption = paste0(
      "Blue = env inputs; amber = PCA composites; green = microbial outcomes.\n",
      "Green arrow = positive, red = negative path. ",
      "Faded = ns (p >= 0.05). Values = std. beta (* p < 0.05)."
    )) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8, colour = "grey40",
                                      lineheight = 1.3))
}

draw_sem_diagram(paths, nodes,
                 node_w = 0.32, node_h = 0.13) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.22, 1.22), ylim = c(0.05, 0.95), clip = "off")
```

## Extended SEM — Microbial richness as terminal outcomes

Vegetation and soil development are hypothesised to drive microbial community
richness (measured as the number of co-occurrence network nodes per plot; source:
`network_n_taxa_by_plot_REVISION.csv`, `Treatment == "all"`). The core model is
extended by adding Bacterial (16S) and Fungal (ITS) richness as terminal outcomes,
allowing both mediated (env → veg → soil → richness) and direct paths.

```{r sem-richness-setup}
# ── Join iteratively-rarefied diversity metrics to sem_data ───────────────────
# rich_raw contains: Plot, Rich_16S, Shan_16S, Rich_ITS, Shan_ITS
# All four metrics are z-scored for SEM comparability.
sem_data_rich <- sem_data %>%
  left_join(rich_raw, by = "Plot") %>%
  mutate(
    Rich16S = as.numeric(scale(Rich_16S)),
    RichITS = as.numeric(scale(Rich_ITS)),
    Shan16S = as.numeric(scale(Shan_16S)),
    ShanITS = as.numeric(scale(Shan_ITS))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rich16S), !is.na(RichITS))

cat("n plots with diversity data:", nrow(sem_data_rich), "\n\n")
cat("Observed genus richness (999-draw mean):\n")
cat("  16S — range:", round(range(sem_data_rich$Rich_16S, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    " | median:", round(median(sem_data_rich$Rich_16S, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
cat("  ITS — range:", round(range(sem_data_rich$Rich_ITS, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    " | median:", round(median(sem_data_rich$Rich_ITS, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n\n")
cat("Shannon H' (999-draw mean):\n")
cat("  16S — range:", round(range(sem_data_rich$Shan_16S, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    " | median:", round(median(sem_data_rich$Shan_16S, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("  ITS — range:", round(range(sem_data_rich$Shan_ITS, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    " | median:", round(median(sem_data_rich$Shan_ITS, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
```

### Microbial richness and Shannon diversity along the glacier retreat gradient — raw values

Raw plot-level microbial diversity metrics (999-rarefaction mean) plotted against
distance from glacier for bacteria (16S) and fungi (ITS). Straight linear trend
lines with 95% confidence intervals summarize direction; panel annotations report
Spearman correlations and FDR-adjusted *p*-values.

```{r microbial-distance-raw-plots, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8}
microbial_diversity_labels <- c(
  Rich_16S = "Bacterial richness",
  Rich_ITS = "Fungal richness",
  Shan_16S = "Bacterial Shannon H'",
  Shan_ITS = "Fungal Shannon H'"
)

microbial_distance_raw <- plot_meta %>%
  select(Plot, Location, Moraine, DistanceFromGlacier) %>%
  left_join(rich_raw, by = "Plot") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(names(microbial_diversity_labels)),
    names_to  = "diversity_metric",
    values_to = "diversity_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diversity_label = microbial_diversity_labels[diversity_metric],
    diversity_label = factor(diversity_label, levels = microbial_diversity_labels),
    Moraine = factor(Moraine, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    Location = factor(Location)
  )

microbial_distance_sp <- microbial_distance_raw %>%
  group_by(diversity_metric, diversity_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    ok <- complete.cases(.x$DistanceFromGlacier, .x$diversity_value)
    if (sum(ok) < 5) {
      return(tibble(rho = NA_real_, p_sp = NA_real_))
    }
    ct <- cor.test(
      .x$DistanceFromGlacier[ok],
      .x$diversity_value[ok],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    tibble(rho = unname(ct$estimate), p_sp = ct$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Padj_sp = p.adjust(p_sp, method = "BH"),
    label = paste0(
      "\u03c1 = ", formatC(rho, digits = 2, format = "f"),
      sig_stars(Padj_sp),
      "\nPadj = ", fmt_p(Padj_sp)
    )
  )

p_microbial_distance_raw <- ggplot(
  microbial_distance_raw,
  aes(x = DistanceFromGlacier, y = diversity_value)
) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
    colour = "grey30", fill = "grey80", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.3,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Moraine, shape = Location),
    size = 3, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = microbial_distance_sp,
    aes(label = label),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.3,
    size = 3, colour = "grey20", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ diversity_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = moraine_colours, name = "Moraine age",
    labels = moraine_labels
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = location_shapes, name = "Location") +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 3.5)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60", size = 3.5))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from glacier (m)",
    y = "Raw microbial diversity value"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.box       = "horizontal",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_microbial_distance_raw
```

```{r sem-richness-fit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sem_model_rich <- '
  # Tier 1: env -> vegetation colonisation
  VegPC1  ~ a1*Dist_z + a2*TopoPC1

  # Tier 2: veg -> soil + direct env effects on soil
  SoilPC1 ~ b*VegPC1 + c1*Dist_z + c2*TopoPC1

  # Tier 3: microbial richness as terminal outcomes
  # Parsimonious model: environment affects richness through vegetation/soil.
  Rich16S ~ d1*VegPC1 + d2*SoilPC1
  RichITS ~ f1*VegPC1 + f2*SoilPC1

  # Correlated residuals — 16S and ITS share unmeasured environmental drivers
  Rich16S ~~ RichITS

  # ── Key indirect effects ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Env -> Soil via Veg
  ind_dist_veg_soil  := a1 * b
  ind_topo_veg_soil  := a2 * b

  # Veg -> richness (direct)  vs via Soil
  ind_veg_soil_16s   := b  * d2
  ind_veg_soil_its   := b  * f2

  # Env -> 16S via Veg and soil-mediated pathways
  ind_dist_veg_16s   := a1 * d1
  ind_dist_soil_16s  := (a1*b + c1) * d2
  ind_topo_veg_16s   := a2 * d1
  ind_topo_soil_16s  := (a2*b + c2) * d2

  # Env -> ITS via Veg and soil-mediated pathways
  ind_dist_veg_its   := a1 * f1
  ind_dist_soil_its  := (a1*b + c1) * f2
  ind_topo_veg_its   := a2 * f1
  ind_topo_soil_its  := (a2*b + c2) * f2
'

sem_rich <- sem(
  sem_model_rich,
  data      = sem_data_rich,
  estimator = "ML",
  se        = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000
)

fit_rich <- fitMeasures(sem_rich, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
cat("Extended model fit:\n"); print(round(fit_rich, 3))
cat("\nR-squared:\n"); print(lavInspect(sem_rich, "r2"))
```

## Extended SEM — Shannon diversity as terminal outcomes

The same model structure as above but using **Shannon H'** (evenness-weighted
diversity) in place of observed genus richness.  Shannon responds differently
from raw richness when dominant genera shift along the succession — compare the
two to distinguish richness gain from evenness restructuring.

```{r sem-shannon-fit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sem_model_shan <- '
  # Tier 1: env -> vegetation colonisation
  VegPC1  ~ a1*Dist_z + a2*TopoPC1

  # Tier 2: veg -> soil + direct env effects
  SoilPC1 ~ b*VegPC1 + c1*Dist_z + c2*TopoPC1

  # Tier 3: Shannon diversity as terminal outcomes
  # Parsimonious model: environment affects diversity through vegetation/soil.
  Shan16S ~ d1*VegPC1 + d2*SoilPC1
  ShanITS ~ f1*VegPC1 + f2*SoilPC1

  # Correlated residuals
  Shan16S ~~ ShanITS

  # Indirect effects
  ind_dist_veg_soil  := a1 * b
  ind_topo_veg_soil  := a2 * b
  ind_veg_soil_16s   := b  * d2
  ind_veg_soil_its   := b  * f2
  ind_dist_veg_16s   := a1 * d1
  ind_dist_soil_16s  := (a1*b + c1) * d2
  ind_topo_veg_16s   := a2 * d1
  ind_topo_soil_16s  := (a2*b + c2) * d2
  ind_dist_veg_its   := a1 * f1
  ind_dist_soil_its  := (a1*b + c1) * f2
  ind_topo_veg_its   := a2 * f1
  ind_topo_soil_its  := (a2*b + c2) * f2
'

sem_shan <- sem(
  sem_model_shan,
  data      = sem_data_rich,
  estimator = "ML",
  se        = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000
)

fit_shan <- fitMeasures(sem_shan, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
cat("Shannon model fit:\n"); print(round(fit_shan, 3))
cat("\nR-squared:\n"); print(lavInspect(sem_shan, "r2"))
```

## SEM sensitivity analyses

The core and richness/Shannon SEMs above use **global PCA scores** (all plots
together), so the composite axes absorb between-location variance.
Two alternative specifications are tested here:

1. **Partial PCA scores** — location centroid removed from all three composites
   before SEM; focuses on within-location succession gradients.
2. **Global PCA + Location** — global scores retained but Location is added as
   an explicit binary predictor in every equation, letting the model estimate
   how much location *per se* explains after accounting for Distance and TopoPC1.

Core model only (4-node: Dist + Topo → Veg → Soil) is used for the sensitivity
analyses to keep degrees of freedom manageable.

### Spec 1 — Partial PCA scores

```{r sem-sens-partial-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(vegan))

# ── Partial RDA site scores (residuals after removing Location means) ─────────
# scaling = 1 returns distance-biplot scores (site scores in units of
# sqrt(eigenvalue)); we z-score afterwards for comparability.
run_partial_rda <- function(mat, meta) {
  ok_cols <- apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  mat     <- mat[, ok_cols, drop = FALSE]
  vegan::rda(mat ~ Condition(Location), data = meta, scale = TRUE)
}

meta_sem <- sem_raw %>% select(Location, Moraine)

rda_cover <- run_partial_rda(
  sem_raw %>% select(all_of(cover_vars)) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)),
  meta_sem
)
rda_soil  <- run_partial_rda(
  sem_raw %>% select(OM_pct, pH, TN_pct, TP_pct,
                     Na_mg_g, Mg_mg_g, K_mg_g, Ca_mg_g, Texture_2mm) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)),
  meta_sem
)
rda_topo  <- run_partial_rda(
  sem_raw %>% select(all_of(topo_vars_pca)) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)),
  meta_sem
)

# Extract PC1 site scores; align sign with global PC1 (flip if r < 0)
align_sign <- function(partial_scores, global_scores) {
  if (cor(partial_scores, global_scores, use = "complete.obs") < 0)
    -partial_scores else partial_scores
}

pc1_cover_partial <- scores(rda_cover, display = "sites", choices = 1, scaling = 1)[, 1]
pc1_soil_partial  <- scores(rda_soil,  display = "sites", choices = 1, scaling = 1)[, 1]
pc1_topo_partial  <- scores(rda_topo,  display = "sites", choices = 1, scaling = 1)[, 1]

sem_data_partial <- sem_raw %>%
  mutate(
    VegPC1  = as.numeric(scale(align_sign(pc1_cover_partial, pca_cover$x[, 1]))),
    SoilPC1 = as.numeric(scale(align_sign(pc1_soil_partial,  pca_soil$x[, 1]))),
    TopoPC1 = as.numeric(scale(align_sign(pc1_topo_partial,  pca_topo$x[, 1]))),
    Dist_z  = as.numeric(scale(DistanceFromGlacier))
  )

cat("Partial RDA variance explained by Location:\n")
cat("  Cover:", round(RsquareAdj(rda_cover)$r.squared * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("  Soil: ", round(RsquareAdj(rda_soil)$r.squared  * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("  Topo: ", round(RsquareAdj(rda_topo)$r.squared  * 100, 1), "%\n")
```

```{r sem-sens-partial-fit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sem_partial <- sem(
  sem_model,          # same 4-node model string defined in sem-fit
  data      = sem_data_partial,
  estimator = "ML",
  se        = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000
)

fit_partial <- fitMeasures(sem_partial, c("chisq","df","pvalue","cfi","rmsea","srmr"))
cat("Partial PCA SEM fit:\n"); print(round(fit_partial, 3))
cat("\nR-squared:\n"); print(lavInspect(sem_partial, "r2"))
```

```{r sem-sens-partial-rich-trim-fit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Final microbial richness SEM:
# start from Spec 1 (partial PCA) and retain only direct pathways with p <= 0.10.
trim_alpha <- 0.10

partial_rich_direct_full <- parameterEstimates(sem_partial_rich, standardized = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(.data$op == "~") %>%
  mutate(
    keep_path = !is.na(.data$pvalue) & .data$pvalue <= trim_alpha,
    label_use = if_else(!is.na(.data$label) & nzchar(.data$label), .data$label, "")
  )

partial_rich_direct_keep <- partial_rich_direct_full %>%
  filter(.data$keep_path)

if (!nrow(partial_rich_direct_keep)) {
  stop("No Spec 1 richness direct pathways retained at p <= ", trim_alpha)
}

trimmed_direct_lines <- partial_rich_direct_keep %>%
  mutate(
    path_line = if_else(
      nzchar(.data$label_use),
      paste(.data$lhs, "~", paste0(.data$label_use, "*", .data$rhs)),
      paste(.data$lhs, "~", .data$rhs)
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(path_line)

sem_model_partial_rich_trim <- paste(
  "# Direct paths retained from full Spec 1 richness SEM at p <= 0.10",
  paste(trimmed_direct_lines, collapse = "\n"),
  "",
  "# Retain shared marker-level residual covariance",
  "Rich16S ~~ RichITS",
  sep = "\n"
)

cat("Trimmed Spec 1 richness model syntax:\n")
cat(sem_model_partial_rich_trim, "\n")

sem_partial_rich_trim <- sem(
  sem_model_partial_rich_trim,
  data      = sem_data_partial_rich,
  estimator = "ML",
  se        = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 1000
)

fit_pr_trim <- fitMeasures(
  sem_partial_rich_trim,
  c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr")
)
cat("Trimmed Spec 1 richness model fit:\n"); print(round(fit_pr_trim, 3))
cat("\nR-squared:\n"); print(lavInspect(sem_partial_rich_trim, "r2"))
```

```{r sem-sens-partial-rich-trim-compare}
sem_compare_row <- function(fit, model_name, n_paths) {
  fm <- fitMeasures(fit, c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
  r2_vals <- lavInspect(fit, "r2")
  tibble(
    Model = model_name,
    `Direct paths` = n_paths,
    chisq = unname(fm["chisq"]),
    df = unname(fm["df"]),
    p = unname(fm["pvalue"]),
    CFI = unname(fm["cfi"]),
    RMSEA = unname(fm["rmsea"]),
    SRMR = unname(fm["srmr"]),
    AIC = AIC(fit),
    BIC = BIC(fit),
    `R2 bacterial richness` = unname(r2_vals["Rich16S"]),
    `R2 fungal richness` = unname(r2_vals["RichITS"])
  )
}

partial_rich_model_compare <- bind_rows(
  sem_compare_row(
    sem_partial_rich,
    "Full Spec 1 richness SEM",
    sum(partial_rich_direct_full$op == "~")
  ),
  sem_compare_row(
    sem_partial_rich_trim,
    paste0("Trimmed Spec 1 richness SEM (p <= ", trim_alpha, ")"),
    nrow(partial_rich_direct_keep)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(chisq, p, CFI, RMSEA, SRMR, AIC, BIC,
             `R2 bacterial richness`, `R2 fungal richness`), ~ round(.x, 3))
  )

partial_rich_model_compare %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste0(
      "Full vs trimmed Spec 1 microbial richness SEM. ",
      "Trimmed model retains direct pathways with full-model p <= ", trim_alpha, "."
    )
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

partial_rich_direct_full %>%
  transmute(
    Response = dplyr::recode(.data$lhs, !!!rich_node_labels),
    Predictor = dplyr::recode(.data$rhs, !!!rich_node_labels),
    `Full-model p` = round(.data$pvalue, 4),
    `Full-model std. beta` = round(.data$std.all, 3),
    `Retained in trimmed model` = if_else(.data$keep_path, "yes", "no")
  ) %>%
  arrange(Response, `Full-model p`) %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste0(
      "Path-retention audit for trimmed Spec 1 richness SEM ",
      "(threshold: full-model p <= ", trim_alpha, ")."
    )
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```
